_schema.description: In-app announcements to unlicensed instances. Each entry surfaces the envelope in the sidebar footer for users whose role matches. Retire an announcement by deleting its entry.

fields.filename: Basename of a .md file in this folder. No path separators. Must resolve to a real file in announcements/.
fields.role: 'admin' (only NC instance admins see it) | 'everyone' (all users on an unlicensed instance).
fields.version: TeamHub version this announcement targets. A full version (4.20.0) matches only itself; a release line (4.20) matches every 4.20.x.
